theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (t : Finset ι) (s : ι → Set α) : (⋃ i ∈ t, s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard := by
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | [] =>
    trivial
  | h :: tail =>
    let h' := Finset.singleton h
    have : (⋃ i ∈ h', s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ h', (s i).ncard := by
      rw [Finset.coe_singleton]
      exact ncard_le_sum (s h)
    rw [Finset.union_singleton] at this
    rw [Finset.sum_singleton] at this
    constructor
    · exact this
    · apply ncard_le_sum
      intro i
      exact (s i).ncard ≤ (s i).ncard
